history.summary: Add the pack-gated Jalloween title screen and select Hysteria lowest with clouds disabled.
Disable the JEM Release and legacy title layouts whenever JEM Jalloween is enabled so the seasonal background cannot be overdrawn.

notes: This is client presentation only and changes no gameplay registry, network or server-authority fact.
